name: io.github.becomingmountains/req-invoice-mcp
title: Request Network Invoices
description: Create crypto invoices and payment links on Request Network, and track who has paid. No wallet.

environmentVariables.name: REQUEST_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID from dashboard.request.network (or set REQUEST_API_KEY)

environmentVariables.name: REQUEST_DESTINATION_ID
environmentVariables.description: Route ID that receives payment links, from the dashboard

environmentVariables.name: REQUEST_ROUTES
environmentVariables.description: Several Route IDs, comma separated, each optionally =CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.name: REQUEST_PAYEE
environmentVariables.description: Default wallet that receives payments on custom invoices

environmentVariables.name: REQUEST_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Server API key, instead of a Client ID
